headword: {中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}

definitions.explanation: A report given at a midpoint or during the course of a project, investigation, or study, before the final results are available.

examples.japanese: {中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}を{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
{調査|ちょうさ}の{中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}が{来週|らいしゅう}{発表|はっぴょう}される。
examples.english: The interim report of the investigation will be announced next week.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}は{中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}で{問題点|もんだいてん}を{指摘|してき}した。
examples.english: The committee pointed out problems in the interim report.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in business, academic, and governmental contexts. A 中間報告 is given before work is complete, typically to update stakeholders on progress and preliminary findings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}を{出|だ}す (to issue an interim report)
- {中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}を{発表|はっぴょう}する (to announce a progress report)
- {中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}{書|しょ} (interim report document)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最終報告|さいしゅうほうこく}: final report — the completed report at the end of a project
- {経過報告|けいかほうこく}: progress report — similar meaning, emphasizes the ongoing nature
